pull.title: KAFKA-21277: Docker image, support KRaft dynamic quorum (KIP-853) controllers
pull.body:
The Docker image can not start a KRaft dynamic quorum. It formats
controllers for static voters only, and it rejects
`KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS` on controllers.

This PR `STORAGE_FORMAT_ARGS` env var, appended to   `kafka-storage
format`, e.g.  `--initial-controllers <list>` on   every controller, or
`--standalone` / `--no-initial-controllers`.    Controllers may
advertise listeners from   `KAFKA_CONTROLLER_LISTENER_NAMES`.  Default
static-voter behaviour is unchanged. Moreover,  I have aded a unit test
in KafkaDockerWrapperTest covers the  new env var.

A manual run with an image built from this branch added a  controller
with kafka-metadata-quorum.sh add-controller.

Apart from that I have verified this by testcontainer, which addded
adding/removing controllers in isolated and combined mode.

Reviewers: Paolo Patierno <ppatierno@live.com>, Federico Valeri <fedevaleri@gmail.com>, Luke Chen <showuon@gmail.com>

reviews.body: This may be useful for testing. Could you also create Docker compose examples for dynamic quorum? Plaintext is enough.
LGTM! I agree it'd be better if we can have an example yaml file.

review_comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -85,6 +85,14 @@ Running in SASL mode
 - The Docker image `configure` script will log a warning if `KAFKA_OPTS` does not contain the `java.security.auth.login.config` property when SASL listeners are detected.
 - For more details on SASL mechanisms and configuration, refer to the [Kafka SASL authentication documentation](https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/#security_sasl).
 
+Dynamic controller quorum
+-------------------------
+
+- By default the image formats storage for static voters (`KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_VOTERS`).
+- For a dynamic quorum (KIP-853), set `KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS` instead and pass the format option of each controller in `STORAGE_FORMAT_ARGS`: `--standalone` on the first controller, `--no-initial-controllers` on the others (they join as observers and are added with `kafka-metadata-quorum.sh add-controller`).
review_comments.body: It should be used even with `--initial-controllers` to pass the entire list of controllers since the beginning.

issue_comments.body: What bothers me is why the dynamic quorum formatting is not a first class citizen in the Docker image instead of relegated to be only part of an additional argument within the tooling? Was this discussed in a KIP?

> What bothers me is why the dynamic quorum formatting is not a first class citizen in the Docker image instead of relegated to be only part of an additional argument within the tooling? Was this discussed in a KIP?

No, no KIP has covered it. IMO using `STORAGE_FORMAT_ARGS` is the smallest change that makes dynamic quorum possible with the current image.

> No, no KIP has covered it. IMO using STORAGE_FORMAT_ARGS is the smallest change that makes dynamic quorum possible with the current image.

I totally understand it's the smallest and fastest way to enable dynamic quorum in the image but is it really what the community wants for Kafka instead of a proper refactoring? If this is a temporary workaround I think there should be also a long term goal about this.

> > No, no KIP has covered it. IMO using STORAGE_FORMAT_ARGS is the smallest change that makes dynamic quorum possible with the current image.
> 
> I totally understand it's the smallest and fastest way to enable dynamic quorum in the image but is it really what the community wants for Kafka instead of a proper refactoring? If this is a temporary workaround I think there should be also a long term goal about this.

`STORAGE_FORMAT_ARGS` does not conflict with that. So I see this PR as the first step that unblocks users today,
not a workaround to be removed later. I agree, that we can discuss long term goal (i.e., making dynamic quorum a first-class mode of the image) but that would need short follow-up **KIP** I think.
When you have time can you please check @showuon @mimaison @fvaleri?
Also, merge conflicts need to be resolved.
Fixed and I have added examples @fvaleri @showuon.
@showuon once you find a time. @chia7712 if you are interest or @dino2895 as you did also few tasks within Docker images.

+    - Dynamic quorum:
+        - Same as the Plaintext example, but the controllers form a dynamic quorum (KIP-853) instead of using static voters.
+        - `KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS` replaces `KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_VOTERS`, and each node advertises its controller listener (`CONTROLLER://kafka-1:9093`) in `KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS`.
+        - Every controller gets the same `STORAGE_FORMAT_ARGS="--initial-controllers ..."`. The directory ids in it were generated once with `bin/kafka-storage.sh random-uuid`.
+        - To run the example:
+        ```
+        # Run from root of the repo
+
+        # JVM based Apache Kafka Docker Image
+        $ IMAGE=apache/kafka:latest docker compose -f docker/examples/docker-compose-files/cluster/combined/dynamic_quorum/docker-compose.yml up
+
+        # GraalVM based Native Apache Kafka Docker Image
+        $ IMAGE=apache/kafka-native:latest docker compose -f docker/examples/docker-compose-files/cluster/combined/dynamic_quorum/docker-compose.yml up
+        ```
+        - To describe the quorum:
+        ```
+        # Run from root of the repo
+        $ bin/kafka-metadata-quorum.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:29092 describe --replication
+        ```
 - Isolated:

+    - Dynamic quorum:
+        - Same as the Plaintext example, but the controllers form a dynamic quorum (KIP-853) instead of using static voters.
+        - `KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS` replaces `KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_VOTERS` on controllers and brokers.
+        - Controllers set `KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS` to their controller listener only (`CONTROLLER://controller-1:9093`). Brokers format without `STORAGE_FORMAT_ARGS`.
+        - Every controller gets the same `STORAGE_FORMAT_ARGS="--initial-controllers ..."`. The directory ids in it were generated once with `bin/kafka-storage.sh random-uuid`.
+        - To run the example:

+        # Run from root of the repo
+
+        # JVM based Apache Kafka Docker Image
+        $ IMAGE=apache/kafka:latest docker compose -f docker/examples/docker-compose-files/cluster/isolated/dynamic_quorum/docker-compose.yml up
+
+        # GraalVM based Native Apache Kafka Docker Image
+        $ IMAGE=apache/kafka-native:latest docker compose -f docker/examples/docker-compose-files/cluster/isolated/dynamic_quorum/docker-compose.yml up
+        ```
+        - To describe the quorum:
+        ```
+        # Run from root of the repo
+        $ bin/kafka-metadata-quorum.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:29092 describe --replication
+        ```
 
 - Note that the examples are meant to be tried one at a time, make sure you close an example server before trying out the other to avoid conflicts.

 - For more details on SASL mechanisms and configuration, refer to the [Kafka SASL authentication documentation](https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/#security_sasl).
 
+### Dynamic controller quorum
+
+- By default the image formats storage for static voters (`KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_VOTERS`).
+- For a dynamic quorum (KIP-853), set `KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS` instead and pass the `kafka-storage format` option that sets up the quorum in `STORAGE_FORMAT_ARGS`:
+  - `--initial-controllers` forms the whole quorum from the start. Pass the same value to every controller, e.g. `STORAGE_FORMAT_ARGS="--initial-controllers 1@controller-1:9093:<directory-id-1>,2@controller-2:9093:<directory-id-2>,3@controller-3:9093:<directory-id-3>"`. Generate each directory id once with `kafka-storage.sh random-uuid`; every controller formats its metadata log directory with its own id from the list.
+  - Alternatively, start with a single voter and grow the quorum later: `--standalone` on the first controller, `--no-initial-controllers` on the others. They join as observers and are added with `kafka-metadata-quorum.sh add-controller`.
+- `STORAGE_FORMAT_ARGS` is appended to the image's `kafka-storage format` command, so any of its options can be passed.
+- Each controller must advertise its controller listener, e.g. `KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS=CONTROLLER://controller-1:9093`. On a controller, `KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS` may only list listeners from `KAFKA_CONTROLLER_LISTENER_NAMES`.
+- See the `dynamic_quorum` Docker Compose examples for combined and isolated mode in the [Kafka repository](https://github.com/apache/kafka/blob/trunk/docker/examples/README.md).
+
 ### Running in SSL mode
 
 - The recommended way to run in SSL mode is by mounting secrets on `/etc/kafka/secrets` in the Docker container and providing the following configs through environment variables: `KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_FILENAME`, `KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_CREDENTIALS`, `KAFKA_SSL_KEY_CREDENTIALS`, `KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_FILENAME` and `KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_CREDENTIALS`. This lets the Docker image scripts extract passwords and populate the correct paths in `server.properties`.
